item.title: Brent Smith Says ‘The Audience Is the Boss’ as Shinedown Releases New Single ‘Killing Fields’; Watch
item.description: Shinedown has released a new single called Killing Fields (listen below). The track is now available on all major streaming platforms. It was released through Atlantic Records.

item.title: Former SLIPKNOT Drummer JAY WEINBERG Says Upcoming Solo Album Reflects Years of Quiet Work and Creative Freedom: 'I'm Playing Everything on It'
item.description: Former Slipknot drummer Jay Weinberg is preparing to release his first solo album, a project he has quietly developed over the past decade. Speaking on the Podioslave Podcast, Weinberg described the work as deeply personal, creatively ambitious, and long overdue.

item.title: Former PEARL JAM Drummer DAVE ABBRUZZESE Breaks Silence on Rumored Comeback After MATT CAMERON Exit
item.description: Matt Cameron recently stepped away from his role as drummer for Pearl Jam, ending a nearly 30-year run. He didn’t explain why, and the band hasn’t named a replacement, leaving fans and the music press to fill in the blanks.

item.title: BRING ME THE HORIZON Teases New Project With Lo-Fi Versions of Their Songs
item.description: Bring Me The Horizon is exploring a different vibe. On Tuesday (8), the British band shared on Instagram that they’ve been working on a new project featuring lo-fi reinterpretations of their songs.

item.title: OZZY OSBOURNE Receives 'Unbelievable' Emotional Gift From YUNGBLUD Before Final BLACK SABBATH Performance in Birmingham; VIDEO
item.description: As Ozzy Osbourne prepared to take the stage one last time with Black Sabbath, another artist was waiting backstage with something a bit unexpected. Yungblud, the genre-bending musician from Doncaster, brought more than just his performance to Villa Park in Birmingham.

item.title: After Decades of Defining PEARL JAM’s Sound, Drummer MATT CAMERON Steps Down Without Warning: 'I Am Forever Grateful To The Crew'
item.description: Pearl Jam has confirmed that drummer Matt Cameron is leaving the band after nearly three decades behind the kit. The news came through coordinated statements from both Cameron and the band on social media, catching many longtime fans off guard.

item.title: GREEN DAY Frontman Kicks Fan Off Stage for Playing OASIS Song Instead of 'Good Riddance': 'Are You Kidding Me?'
item.description: A Green Day concert in Luxembourg took an unexpected turn this week after a fan brought onstage tried to play the wrong song. The incident happened Monday during the band’s Saviors Tour stop at the Luxexpo in Luxembourg.

item.title: FOO FIGHTERS Release 'TODAY’S SONG' Ahead of Album’s 30th Anniversary; VIDEO
item.description: Foo Fighters have released a new track titled “Today’s Song” (watch below) to celebrate the upcoming 30th anniversary of their self-titled debut album. The single is available now on major streaming platforms.

item.title: How One EMBARRASSING Night at 'Whiskey A Go Go' Forced LINKIN PARK to Find CHESTER BENNINGTON
item.description: Linkin Park rose to become one of the most influential rock bands of the 21st century. Known for blending heavy guitar riffs, hip-hop beats, and electronic layers, the group built a sound that was both accessible and intense.

item.title: EVANESCENCE Hits No. 1 on Rock Chart for the First Time With 'Afterlife'
item.description: Evanescence has reached a major milestone. The band has scored its first-ever No. 1 song on Billboard’s Mainstream Rock Airplay chart with “Afterlife”, their latest single featured in the Netflix series Devil May Cry (watch below).

item.title: LIMP BIZKIT’s WES BORLAND’s Controversial Take on Heavy Metal: 'Boring As F*ck'
item.description: Wes Borland, guitarist for Limp Bizkit, has never exactly fit the mold of a typical nü-metal poster boy. Known for his elaborate stage costumes and artistic detours, Borland has always appeared slightly out of place next to Fred Durst’s red Yankees cap and the band’s frat-rap aggression.

item.title: HOLLYWOOD UNDEAD Releases Emotional New Single 'SAVIOR': 'We Can’t Wait For You To Hear It'
item.description: Rock group Hollywood Undead has dropped a new single titled “Savior” (watch it below), offering fans a more personal and emotional look at the band’s sound. The track is out now through Sumerian Records.

item.title: The Lemonheads Drop New Single “In The Margin,” Share Details on First Album in Nearly 20 Years
item.description: After years of writing, drifting, and starting over, Evan Dando is back. The Lemonheads are set to release their first studio album in almost two decades, titled Love Chant, arriving October 24 via Fire Records.

item.title: JACOBY SHADDIX Talks New PAPA ROACH Single With TOBY MORSE: 'It Felt Urgent, Honest, In Your Face'
item.description: Papa Roach is back with a new single, and they’ve brought along a longtime friend. The California rock band just released “Braindead” (watch it below), a high-energy track featuring Toby Morse, the lead singer of punk band H2O.

item.title: Creed's SCOTT STAPP On Viral Revival: 'It Started Online Before We Even Noticed'
item.description: Scott Stapp says the Creed reunion didn’t start with a grand plan or a flashy PR campaign. It began with the internet doing its thing. In a recent interview (via Meltdown), the singer explained that the band started to see signs of renewed interest around 2020, when clips, memes, and jokes about Creed started to go viral.

item.title: Dave 'PHOENIX' Farrell Talks LINKIN PARK’s Return: 'Time Doesn’t Heal The Wound, It Changes The Lens'
item.description: Linkin Park is back on tour with a new album and new members. But for bassist Dave “Phoenix” Farrell, returning to the band after Chester Bennington’s death was not easy.

item.title: Dave 'PHOENIX' Farrell Breaks Silence on CHESTER BENNINGTON’s Death: 'Is It Even Called LINKIN PARK Anymore?'
item.description: Linkin Park bassist Dave “Phoenix” Farrell opened up about the band’s long road back to music after the loss of lead singer Chester Bennington. In a new interview with Czech station Evropa 2 (transcribed by BLABBERMOUTH.

item.title: AVRIL LAVIGNE And DERYCK WHIBLEY Reunite Onstage 15 Years After Divorce
item.description: Avril Lavigne brought a familiar face on stage during her set at the Vans Warped Tour 30th anniversary show in Washington, DC this past Sunday. The surprise guest?

item.title: SCOTT STAPP Says CREED Is Rebuilding: 'We're Talking About New Music'
item.description: CREED frontman Scott Stapp says the band is easing back into things after more than a decade apart. In a recent interview, he shared that the group has been spending time together, reflecting on the past, and having early conversations about making new music (via Meltdown) (transcribed by BLABBERMOUTH.

item.title: Linkin Park’s EMILY ARMSTRONG Shaves Fan's Head on Stage at ROCK FOR PEOPLE 2025
item.description: Linkin Park opened their summer festival season with a big moment at Rock for People 2025. The band performed in front of 50,000 fans, but one person in the crowd definitely stood out.

item.title: LINKIN PARK Cancels Switzerland Concert After Health Problem in Band: 'We’re Not In A Spot To Perform Tonight'
item.description: Linkin Park called off their performance in Bern, Switzerland just hours before showtime, citing a medical issue within the band. The June 20 concert at Bernexpo was part of the group’s 2025 world tour promoting From Zero, their first album since 2017.

item.title: Nirvana's "Smells Like Teen Spirit" Surpasses 2 Billion YouTube Views
item.description: Nirvana’s “Smells Like Teen Spirit” has now passed the 2-billion view mark on YouTube. After first being uploaded in 2009, the video quietly amassed its first billion by 2019.

item.title: Bush’s Gavin Rossdale on the Music Industry: “I Can’t Work Out How Young Bands Get Paid”
item.description: Gavin Rossdale, frontman of Bush, seems genuinely lost when it comes to figuring out how young bands actually make money these days, and honestly? Same. The guy flat-out said, “I can’t work it out,” and if that isn’t the most relatable statement about the modern music industry, I don’t know what is.

item.title: My Chemical Romance Drummer Bob Bryar Found Dead in Tennessee
item.description: The news of Bob Bryar’s passing feels like a gut punch to those who remember his explosive drumming during My Chemical Romance’s most iconic era. At just 44, Bryar was found dead in his Tennessee home on November 26.

item.title: Brad Delson Walks Away from Linkin Park’s Reunion—Here’s Why
item.description: Here we go again. Linkin Park just can’t stop throwing curveballs. First, it’s a new singer. Then, a new album. And, of course, the big reunion tour. But now?

item.title: Linkin Park Releases "Friendly Fire" Featuring Chester Bennington
item.description: Art has a way of keeping artists alive, doesn’t it? Even when they’re gone, their work lingers on, creating an odd form of immortality. Linkin Park just gave fans a bittersweet reminder of that idea by releasing “Friendly Fire”, an unreleased track featuring the unmistakable vocals of the late Chester Bennington.
